archetype: family farm with roomed farmhouse, aisle barn, silo, machinery shed and irrigated fields
domestic_program: pantry and mudroom beside the rear farmyard exit
pitched roof, front road approach and rear service connection
agricultural_program: north-south threshing aisle with wagon doors at both ends
four side animal stalls with water
traversable twin haylofts and rear crossover bridge
machinery shed with repair bay, fuel and secure parts storage
three crop sections with irrigation and a muddy service lane
circulation: county road connects farmhouse front walk and central service yard
farmhouse rear mudroom exits toward silo, barn and fields
barn wagon aisle links both doors, tack/feed rooms and all four stalls
six-rise stair reaches both haylofts through the rear bridge
field-edge lane connects crops to the machinery shed and barnyard
damage_constraints: confine farmhouse failure to the northwest roof and living-room edge
confine barn failure to the northeast loft and roof
preserve bedroom, washroom, pantry, both house exits and rear mudroom
preserve barn wagon aisle, southwest loft, both wagon doors and machinery shed
derive field decay and hostile occupation from the immutable clean master

required_manual_checks: farmhouse rooms read as a plausible working rural home
barn aisle, four stalls, tack/feed rooms and hayloft work at player scale
silo, field rows and machinery shed communicate an agricultural workflow
the hayloft stair and rear crossover are safely traversable
zombie and husk pressure is dangerous without trapping mandatory routes
localized structural failures and terrain feathering read naturally in-world
